comment: Independent C-first carried fire-scroll cure scout. Expanded own C map places generated ogre on dropped scroll stack (20,10) and hero (20,11). Previous hostile south step remained lined_up and prevented monmove.c m_move getitems. Source-guided cheap route: move southeast to (21,12), where displacement (1,2) from the ogre is not orthogonal or diagonal; the hostile item-search gate can then select its current pile and postmov calls mpickstuff. Require actual pickup text. Correct source attribution: find_offensive SCR_FIRE is disabled by #if 0; fire resistance is irrelevant to that disabled selector. Prior scout6 recorder attempt had no recipe because of a helper assignment error; its failure log remains preserved. C scout7 confirmed hero at (21,12), ogre remains at pile (20,10), but initial movement did not establish pickup. Add three real forced turns to cover the ogre movement allotment while out of line. C328 explicitly proves ogre picked up all ten actual fire scrolls. Final expanded map hero (21,12), ogre (20,11). Controlled #polyself green slime consumes no time; force attack northwest. Preserve ten independently designed forced attacks, source rn2(4) sliming chance, and require actual mreadmsg/explosion RNG rather than assume cure. Peaceful pickup scouts could never succeed: mon.c can_carry returns zero for peaceful nontame monsters; this corrects the earlier item-search-only diagnosis.
